name: Karumonix
description: A Phyrexian creature formed when rats ate each other and their bones fused; it can sense and manipulate rodents.

description_citations.text: "Rat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian rats grow so numerous that they eat each other and their bones fuse into Karumonix.
timeline.quote: Eventually, rats became so numerous that some began to eat each other, and their bones began to fuse.
